description: Bring P0 and P1 world assets to their bars, game-used first
deviation_notes: Batch 1 is the 55 world assets that the ported games reference or that are P0, without a recorded score at the bar. Ground tiles: the top moved to y = 0 (the forge-assets terrain rule) instead of the old standing heights; farm-field became an overlay rework, not a slab. The P0 acceptance and P1 family tracks (architecture, nature, props, equipment) use this track's results; they are not prerequisites.
